The Shining Man arrived on [[Voss]] only a matter of [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[Imperial Attack on Voss|discovered]], meaning that the planet's discovery took place less than eight years prior to Act III, the events of which [[Template:TOR dates|can be placed in]] [[3640 BBY]]. Finally, {{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Request An Audience|Voss}} establishes that the [[Unidentified Emperor's Voice (Voss)|Voss host]] for the Emperor was taken simultaneously with the planet's discovery. {{TORcite|type=codex|The Voice of the Emperor (Warrior)}} is set during Act III, and {{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|The Voice of Darkness|Voss}} establishes that the Voss remained as the Voice until Act III. Therefore, the Human female served as the Voice and [[Death/Legends|died]] several years before 3640 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref>

According to one account, a young '''Human female''' served as the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Emperor's Voice]]<ref name="Emperor" /> at some point between [[3950 BBY]] and several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Dates" /> As a Voice of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], their body hosted the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] power and consciousness, being used to issue the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] leader's commands to his servants.<ref name="Emperor" /> At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human's]] [[Death/Legends|death]], as with all the Voices before them, their body was abandoned by the Emperor's essence, which left to take a new host.<ref name="Darkness">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|The Voice of Darkness|Voss}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Human female was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Voice of the Emperor in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Emperor" />
